breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification removes the contradictory statement about the layer being 'rigid in shear' (which would imply no relative slip and thus zero shear deformation). Instead, it simply states the material properties and asks to compute shear strain and lateral displacement using the shear modulus G, consistent with the ground truth prompt. The conflicting rigid-in-shear assumption is not present in the generated output.
